items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Smith, and Ferguson. ... No, this was either a trumpet player or saxophone player. These are the different men in the band.

ctx.x: Henry Glover, trumpet; Bill Doggett, organ. Bernard Mackey played guitar -- that hawaiian guitar.
Johnny Brown, trombone and somebody -- Fields -- Fred Williams, Bess, Jimmy Smith, and Ferguson.
